summary: This document is a development specification for building the NC DHHS Phase 0 Assessment Dashboard prototype, the primary deliverable for a DHHS executive demo. It defines both product requirements and implementation direction: a 6-tab narrative dashboard covering Executive Summary, Regional Map, Provider Readiness, Vendor Evaluation, AI Governance, and Audit & Provenance, with each tab explicitly tied to leadership questions, drill-down interactions, data provenance, and Initiative 6 budget accountability. It specifies concrete UI components such as hero panels, allocation recommendations, critical findings cards, budget waterfall, timelines, interactive regional filtering, and a provider-level readiness table with real-world healthcare metadata. It also gives explicit design and stack constraints: government enterprise visual style using NC state branding, React single-file prototype with Recharts, inline CSS, static JSON demo data, and future production migration to Next.js with hosted deployment and stronger PHI detection via Presidio/custom NER.
